source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.sample_id: Sample.number, 122 unique sample IDs, one focal filmed flower per originally tagged plant
source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.film_day: Julian.day, numeric for 122; eight unique days [176,177,178,182,183,190,191,196]
source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.seed_fitness_response: Seed.set, 93 numeric of 122; remaining 29 string sentinel NA, not biological zeros
source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.source_metadata_Seed_set: Proportion of ovules that developed into mature seeds
source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.source_seedweights_note: Seed.weights metadata says Seed.count + Small.seed + Ovule, but Seed.set source is a separate column and its arithmetic has not been verified before outcome fit
source_metadata_and_outcome_missingness_.note: Only column names, biological unit, source cell types/NA flags, dates, structural denominators examined before prespecified models, not signed seed/CP/HP/visitation relationships.

scientific_question: Does directly observed stigma conspecific and heterospecific pollen load improve prediction of subsequent seed maturation beyond prior visitation by four pollinator groups, phenology and original floral neighborhood, in entirely held-out filming dates?
source_originality: Original authors already found HP×CP seed-set interaction in the same field flowers; our estimand is additional out-of-date predictive utility of measured pollen given raw recorded visitation, NOT first discovery of the mechanism.
unit: one unique focal flower = one source maternal plant, clustered by Julian filming date; 8 heldout date groups from ONE original Pennsylvania grassland

eligibility.seed_response: Seed.set numeric finite within [0,1] only, complete 93; source NA 29 dropped for response modeling but kept for source missingness report
eligibility.pollen: CP.Count and HP.Count numeric finite nonnegative for all 122
eligibility.Q: Four legitimate contact visit counts numeric nonnegative; each divided by source Duration.hours >0 before log1p
eligibility.floral_missingness: For each neighbor variable, form raw log1p for observed source counts; for missing NA, train-only median of log1p available values within eleven? (all other date folds) training observations; add one separate 0/1 missing indicator per field. Heldout missingness never used for imputation parameters.
eligibility.do_not_exclude: Retain all 93 seed-complete flowers including Julian day 196 with zero observed neighborhood fields (impute using training-only medians). No deleting 0-visits, outliers, low pollen, or small day folds.
eligibility.checking: Source-data CRC/SHA, unique 122 IDs, 8 dates, 93 seed-set numeric, 6 NA neighborhood rows and 5 overlapping 93; fail closed on any denominator drift.

fixed_model.response: Original Seed.set ratio, squared-error risk on 0–1 scale; no conditional seed count overdispersion estimator and no treatment effect
fixed_model.model_M0: intercept + Julian.day (numeric) + log1p(Con.abundance) + log1p(Het.abundance) + two corresponding missingness indicators + each of four log1p(legitimate guild visits / Duration.hours)
fixed_model.interaction_reason: Prior authors already documented nonlinear HP×CP seed relationship. The fixed joint transfer term tests predictive benefit of that known interaction, not novel effect discovery.
fixed_model.imputation: For each of two floral neighborhood log1p variables impute only from training flowers' median; holdout date response never influences imputation.
fixed_model.standardization: For each training fold, center and scale all non-intercept covariates with training mean and population SD; for zero SD use 1, and penalize its coefficient as usual.
fixed_model.estimator: Gaussian ridge closed-form least squares with lambda=1 for non-intercept standardized predictors; intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter fitting
fixed_model.prediction: Clamp both M0/M1 forecast Seed.set to [0,1] before scoring
fixed_model.CV: leave one whole Julian filming day out (8 folds), all flowers from that day held out including date196; no random flower folds
fixed_model.primary_estimand: pooled flower-weighted average heldout MSE(M0)-MSE(M1); positive means pollen transfer added predictive information beyond visitation and floral context
fixed_model.success_gate: M0-M1 pooled MSE improvement >=5% of M0 MSE AND strictly positive MSE(M0)-MSE(M1) in >=6/8 heldout dates
fixed_model.reporting: n per 8 dates, M0/M1 MSE and MAE, pooled 93 MSE/MAE, exact n missing/non-missing response and floral context, source SHA, no per-flower biology rows
fixed_model.secondary: Describe absolute MAE and date-fold signs only. No posthoc alternative pollinevent taxon feature/response/HP-only threshold/model to rescue primary.

nonindependence.observational_horizon: video followed by next-day stigma harvest and mature fruit collection about 3 weeks later
nonindependence.selection: 29/122 mature-fruit results not observed due to missing fruits or herbivory; complete case 93 not necessarily missing at random
nonindependence.causal: Pollen grain counts are deposited grains, not necessarily compatible fertilization or genetically identified paternal source
nonindependence.no_generalization: No urban/island common regime, universal mechanistic causal threshold, independent species replication, ecological function decline or genetic rescue inferred.

governance: Preserve this exact protocol-only commit before new seed-set/pollen predictive model fitting; merge with history (not squash).
No external original XLSX or flower-level values committed to public GitHub.
Do not look for favorable alternate source responses or plot/site subsets if the primary fails.
Use author-populated source glossary for metadata, not reinterpret the source cell labels or missing NA as 0.
Public 2021 paper has already published interaction HP×CP; original published finding is prior art.
